model.name: AudioSR
model.description: Versatile audio super-resolution: upsamples any audio (music, speech, sound effects, any input sample rate) to 48 kHz high fidelity. Wraps the upstream GitHub project's public API (audiosr.build_model + audiosr.super_resolution); the package is installed from git as a pip dependency, so no Space duplicate is required.
model.author: haoheliu

inputs.name: input_audio
inputs.label: Input audio (any sample rate)
inputs.info: Low-resolution audio to upsample. AudioSR resamples to 48 kHz mono internally; works best on low-pass-style cutoffs (see the model README on cutoff patterns).

inputs.name: model_name
inputs.label: Model checkpoint
inputs.info: 'basic' for general audio (music, sound effects); 'speech' is tuned for voice.

inputs.name: ddim_steps
inputs.label: DDIM steps
inputs.info: Sampling steps. More steps = higher quality but slower (the README's recommended default is 50).

inputs.name: guidance_scale
inputs.label: Guidance scale
inputs.info: Higher = better fidelity/relevance; lower = more diversity.

inputs.name: seed
inputs.label: Random seed
inputs.info: Change for a different stochastic result.

inference.setup:
import numpy as np
import soundfile as sf

# Import the model's real public API straight from the pip-installed GitHub
# package (see framework.pip). build_model + super_resolution are exported by
# audiosr/__init__.py, so the wrapper reuses the upstream pipeline verbatim.
from audiosr import build_model, super_resolution

# Cache one model per checkpoint name. Models are built lazily inside the
# (GPU-decorated) process_fn so the CUDA allocation happens in the GPU context
# -- the correct pattern for Hugging Face ZeroGPU Spaces as well as plain GPU
# hosts and local CPU smoke-tests.
_MODELS = {}


def _get_model(model_name):
    if model_name not in _MODELS:
        _MODELS[model_name] = build_model(model_name=model_name)
    return _MODELS[model_name]
inference.body:
model = _get_model(model_name)
waveform = super_resolution(
    model,
    input_audio,
    seed=int(seed),
    ddim_steps=int(ddim_steps),
    guidance_scale=float(guidance_scale),
    latent_t_per_second=12.8,
)
# super_resolution returns a (batch, channel, samples) array; flatten to mono 1-D.
audio = np.asarray(waveform).squeeze()
output_path = "audiosr_output.wav"
sf.write(output_path, audio, 48000)
return output_path
